sources.title: Fictional account records API
sources.content: GET /v1/records requires accountId as a trusted query parameter. Authentication is API_KEY in X-Customer-Key, using the existing providerKey installation secret-reference field; never a literal key. One response page only; pagination strategy NONE. HTTP 200 JSON example: {"records":[{"id":"record-A","accountId":"fictional-account","title":"Delivery guide","description":"Approved delivery guidance"}]}. Collection pointer /records; per-record identity /id; ownership /accountId; searchable content /description; title /title. No deletion flags, tombstones or webhook contract are supplied. Use an explicit 900-second periodic schedule. This fictional example is documentation only and no endpoint should be called.
